title: Authentication Log Schema (v1)
description: The one documented security-log schema for SENTINEL Forge's initial scope. See docs/schema/authentication-log-schema.md for the annotated, human-readable version.

account_id.description: Username or service-account identifier. Default grouping key.

source_host.description: Hostname or IP of the originating machine.

source_ip.description: Frequently absent for internal-network sessions in this environment. NOT in the required list on purpose — see docs/schema/authentication-log-schema.md.
